**The idea in one sentence**
What should EngCode be able to do that it can't today?

**How a learner would write it**
Show the syntax you would like to use, in EngCode:

```eng
when the button is clicked:
  ...
end
```

**Why it belongs in EngCode**
Does it remove a hurdle between a beginner and a running program? The roadmap picks things by that rule. Ideas that only impress experienced developers will wait.

**Have you checked the docs?**
- [ ] I searched [docs/grammar.md](../../docs/grammar.md) and [docs/cheatsheet.md](../../docs/cheatsheet.md) for an existing word for this
